candidates.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
candidates.summary: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.

candidates.title: Pay with confidence: How Solv Labs built verifiable, auditable agent payments on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
candidates.summary: Solv Labs built a governed agent-payments workflow on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments, where every transaction is authorized, attested in an AWS Nitro Enclave, priced for risk, and anchored to a public blockchain before settlement. See how the pattern gives enterprises a verifiable, auditable trail for autonomous agent payments in regulated environments.

candidates.title: How OneAdvanced deployed over 50 AI agents on UK-sovereign AWS
candidates.summary: Learn how OneAdvanced, a UK enterprise software provider, built a UK-sovereign AI platform by self-hosting Llama 4 Maverick and Llama Guard 4 on Amazon SageMaker AI, with a RAG pipeline on pgvector and over 50 agents built with Strands Agents SDK on Amazon ECS.

candidates.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
candidates.summary: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

candidates.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
candidates.summary: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

candidates.title: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
candidates.summary: See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.

candidates.title: AMIE, our research medical AI system, demonstrates real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a first-of-its-kind study.
candidates.summary: Google introduces AMIE for real-time clinical video consultations in simulated settings.
